title: [review] messaging.py:159: Exception in _sent_detail_regi
description: After recording message in _sent (line 150), if the registrar callback throws an exception, deliver() is never called (line 160 is skipped). This leaves the message in _sent but not in _inbox, creating an inconsistent state. Unlike the receipt handler (lines 239-245), this callback has no exception handling. If the registrar fails, the message is recorded as sent but never delivered to inbox, and the client receives an error despite partial success.
